job.title: Business Analyst Media Assets (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a business analyst who understands both media processes and the data flows behind them – I have analysed requirements and designed PIM/MDM data pipelines for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT
– Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Business Analyst | Requirements, Process Mapping & Asset/Content Data Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional business analyst with 5+ years on enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Gathers and analyses business requirements with stakeholders, maps processes, performs gap analysis and writes user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications. Experienced with content and product data flows: PIM and MDM integration, file-based data pipelines, catalog synchronization across global channels and data consistency. Supports user acceptance testing, works agile with Jira and Confluence and uses generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Bayard publishes media that reach families and readers every day, and well-structured media assets are the backbone of that work. My five years of requirements analysis, process mapping and content/product data integration across PIM and MDM systems for Rockwell Automation and Shell let me help your teams organise and use assets more effectively.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Business Analyst Media Assets role fits my background: 5+ years of requirements analysis, process mapping and PIM/MDM data pipelines for Rockwell Automation and Shell, plus AI-assisted documentation. Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Business Analyst Media Assets
en.hook: Managing media assets well means understanding both the business processes and the data flows behind them. That is where I work: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have analysed requirements with business teams and designed how product and content data moves between PIM, MDM and digital channels.

bullets.label: Requirements analysis
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role, analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; at Shell, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Asset & content data flows
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Data quality & consistency
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee; engineered API migrations that improved data consistency.

bullets.label: Documentation & efficiency
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis and documentation; worked agile with Jira and Confluence.

en.logistics: I bridge business and IT naturally and bring a precise eye for data structures. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about your media asset landscape in Cologne.
